Christianity.description: Basileia Rhomania's state faith, as set by Tom. Provisional map name, to confirm as Christianity or a more specific rite.
Christianity.perk: +10% morale when defending a province of your own religion
Christianity.debuff: -1 stability in provinces of a different religion, unless tolerated (tolerance gives a trade/relations bonus instead)

Imperial Cult of the Empress.description: Provisional Verillian religion, based on Blake's Empress-led nation and its warrior society/order: veneration of the Empress as living sovereign, upheld by a martial order. Name chosen by Andora on Blake's 'do what you need to do' instruction, 1 Nov 2026 — Blake can rename it with one data edit, no rebuild.
Imperial Cult of the Empress.perk: +10% morale when defending a province of your own religion; warrior order gives +10% morale in holy/defensive wars (do not stack with a trait giving the same bonus in the same situation)
Imperial Cult of the Empress.debuff: -1 stability in provinces of a different religion, unless tolerated (tolerance gives a trade/relations bonus instead)
